A.C.i.D. F/W Collection (Korean: 에시드 F/W 컬렉션 모델, esideu F/W keollegsyeon model) is Chocolate Bonbon Cookie's first Costume, released in the first half of the Super Fashion Week update. It is a Super Epic Costume that could have been obtained by the player choosing between it or  Choc'au Latte F/W Collection during the Super Fashion Week event mode, or purchasing it in the Package Shop.


A.C.i.D. F/W Collection, alongside Choc'au Latte F/W Collection, have since returned twice, being featured in limited Chance Up! banners in the Costume Gacha. It first returned during the second half of the Project Cookie Runway update,[1] and returned again during the second half of the Catch! Teeniepings Ready to Run! update.


Story

"A.C.i.D. Fall & Winter collection's keyword: Layered! This look keeps the emphasis on a youthful style, consisting of a layered, sleeveless dress that captures the essence of its long Jelly fabric, matched with a similarly colored hairband. The jacket worn in shrugged shoulder fashion really shows A.C.i.D.'s signature style! The neutral expression fits so well it almost seems tailored to the concept too."
- Cogue Magazine

Trivia

  • A.C.i.D. F/W Collection was released alongside  Starpath Conjurer,  Choc'au Latte F/W Collection,  Red Carpet Attire,  Superstar Airport Attire, and  Choc'au Latte Model.
  • A.C.i.D. F/W Collection is the first instance of the costume being released before the Cookie.
  • Red Carpet Attire can be seen on one of the billboards of A.C.i.D. F/W Collection's skill background.
  • On the left side of A.C.i.D. F/W Collection's skill background, Yogurt Cream Cookie, Lilac Cookie, Rose Cookie, Raspberry Mousse Cookie, Popping Candy Cookie, Shining Glitter Cookie, and Spinach Cookie can be seen. On the right side of A.C.i.D. F/W Collection's skill background, Lemon Cookie, Cherry Blossom Cookie, Cocoa Cookie, Blackberry Cookie, Adventurer Cookie, Cheesecake Cookie, and Rockstar Cookie can be seen.
